class.name: SceneSpawnPoint
class.brief_description: A named arrival marker inside a scene.
class.description: When [SceneManager] finishes loading a scene it looks for the [SceneSpawnPoint] whose [member spawn_id] matches the requested spawn (searching the [code]scene_spawn_points[/code] group) and reports that node's global transform so the player can be placed there. Drop one just inside each door.

method.name: get_spawn_transform
method.description: The global transform the player should be moved to. With [member use_flat_orientation] the basis is a pure yaw rotation.

members.member: Identifier a [SceneDoor.target_spawn] or [method SceneManager.travel_to] refers to.
Drop pitch and roll from the reported transform, keeping only yaw — usually what an upright character body wants.
